lineComment.description: A comment on lines of a pull's diff.

line.description: The last line commented on, counting from 1, in the file as it is on that side.

path.description: The file's path on the side commented on.

side.description: `new`, the side the pull brings in, or `old`, the side it leaves. Absent, `new`.

startLine.description: The first, for more than one line.

main.description: Writes a dev.knotless.comment record in the account logged in to this appview's web pages, as `knotless comment add` does: with a verdict, a review of the pull's head as it is now. Requires the session cookie the pages' login sets: the appview writes with the session it keeps for that account. Clients holding their own session write the record themselves.

errors.description: No account is logged in to the pages, or its session has ended.
errors.name: AuthenticationRequired

images.description: Pictures uploaded with dev.knotless.uploadImage; those the body links to are attached.

lines.description: Comments on lines of a pull's diff, at its head as it is now, each starting a thread, written at once: as the review's when it has a body or a verdict, else on their own.

repo.description: The repository's dev.knotless.repo record, as dev.knotless.getRepo takes it.

subject.description: The dev.knotless.pull or dev.knotless.issue commented on; or a dev.knotless.comment to answer, in the thread it starts or is in.

verdict.description: For a review of a pull: `approve`, or `changes` to ask for changes.

uri.description: The dev.knotless.comment record written: with lines, the review, or without one the first line comment.

description: Comments on a pull or an issue, or on lines of a pull's diff, or answers a comment, or reviews a pull, as the account logged in to this appview's pages.
